bundle_confirmation: Dependencies or pack members changed and need confirmation together
skipped: This version didn’t start last time, so the previous version was restored
skipped_by_user: You rolled back from this version, so it won’t be installed automatically. Update by hand to install it
paused_disabled: Paused while the extension is off; your setting applies again when you turn it on
package_more_permissions: The downloaded package asks for more permissions than its index says
rolled_back_body: {name} {version} didn’t start, so it’s back on {from} and won’t auto-update to this version again
not_from_market: Only extensions installed from a marketplace update automatically
